name: Training To Climb [💪2X]
desc:
💪Welcome to Train To Climb!
🌍Start your journey as a newbie and work out! Build the mightiest muscles, climb all the way to the top, and unlock brand-new worlds!

【How to Play】
💪Do various workouts to strengthen your body!
💰Buy pets to boost your workout multipliers!
🎮Climb and jump to earn coins!
☁️Keep climbing upward until you reach the peak!
